name: FireworksRecipes
description: Fireworks 配方目录（manifest 驱动，等同 recipes.vllm.ai 的 /models.json）。每条 = 一个可一键安装并发布到 DGX Spark 集群的模型配方；nodes/tensor_parallel 为固定拓扑（发布时必须恰好匹配，模型参数按此调优）。
description_en: Fireworks recipe catalog (manifest-driven, the equivalent of recipes.vllm.ai's /models.json). Each entry is a model recipe you can install and publish to a DGX Spark cluster with one click; nodes/tensor_parallel declare a fixed topology (publish must match exactly, model params are tuned for it).

recipes.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 专属镜像 + 双节点 TP=2 vLLM 服务（主流 vLLM v0.26.0 + GB10 定向 overlay，InstantTensor 加载 + dspark 投机 MTP；KV=nvfp4_ds_mla · 1M 上下文 · MoE=auto/DeepGEMM）。固定 2 节点拓扑。
recipes.description_en: Dedicated-image + 2-node TP=2 vLLM serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (mainline vLLM v0.26.0 + GB10 overlay, InstantTensor load + dspark speculative MTP; KV=nvfp4_ds_mla · 1M context · MoE=auto/DeepGEMM). Fixed 2-node topology.

recipes.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 双节点 TP=2 DSpark 服务（MiaAI-Lab 参考配方路线，Anemll dspark-vllm-gx10 分发镜像，FlashInfer b12x + dspark 投机，NVFP4 DS-MLA）。原 Fireworks 内置配方，已迁移为配方源标准配方。固定 2 节点拓扑。
recipes.description_en: 2-node TP=2 DSpark serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash (MiaAI-Lab reference route; Anemll dspark-vllm-gx10 distribution image, FlashInfer b12x + dspark speculative, NVFP4 DS-MLA). Formerly Fireworks' built-in recipe, now a standard recipe in this source. Fixed 2-node topology.
